rpghealthbar.config.title: RPG Health Bar
rpghealthbar.config.enabled.tooltip: Turns the whole mod on or off.
rpghealthbar.config.enabled.tooltip.on: the RPG bars replace the vanilla hearts.
rpghealthbar.config.enabled.tooltip.off: the HUD is fully vanilla again, including Iron's own mana bar. Your settings and positions are kept.
rpghealthbar.config.airPosition.tooltip: Where the air bubbles and mount health go, relative to hunger.
stacked above the hunger icons or bar, like vanilla.
stacked under the hunger icons or bar. Useful when health or mana sit above hunger.
rpghealthbar.edit.title: Move HUD
rpghealthbar.edit.hint: Drag the HUD to move it. Arrow keys nudge (Shift: 10px).
rpghealthbar.config.healthUnit.tooltip: Unit for the numbers on the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.absorptionDisplay.to: How absorption (golden hearts) is shown. Example: 16 HP of health, 4 HP of absorption (2 golden hearts), 20 HP max.
rpghealthbar.config.moveHud.tooltip: Drag the bars, XP bar and level number to a new spot as one group, then Save. Arrow keys nudge it.
rpghealthbar.config.armorMode.tooltip.va: the normal armor icons, in the row above the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.armorMode.tooltip.ba: a white bar, half the width of the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.hungerMode.tooltip.v: the normal hunger icons, in the row above the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.hungerMode.tooltip.b: an orange bar, half the width of the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthUnit.tooltip.h: health points, 20 for a full vanilla health bar.
HP divided by 2, so 10 for a full vanilla health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthText.tooltip: Where the numbers (e.g. 16+4/20) go on the health bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthText.tooltip.l: at the left end of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.manaText.tooltip: Where the numbers (e.g. 60/100) go on the mana bar.
rpghealthbar.config.manaText.tooltip.lef: at the left end of the bar.
rpghealthbar.config.healthSize.tooltip: How wide the health bar is.
rpghealthbar.config.healthSize.tooltip.h: half as wide, like the armor and hunger bars. With the mana bar also Half, the two sit side by side.
rpghealthbar.config.manaSize.tooltip: How wide the mana bar is (only shown with Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks).
rpghealthbar.config.manaSize.tooltip.hal: half as wide, like the armor and hunger bars. With the health bar also Half, the two sit side by side.
rpghealthbar.config.itemNameOffset.toolt: Moves the held item's name up (+) or down (-), in pixels, when the HUD isn't above the hotbar.
leaves room for hotbar mods, like extra hotbars.
brings it down, to right above the hotbar at the value shown below. Looks better without such mods.
rpghealthbar.config.itemName.tooltip: Set how high the held item's name sits, with a preview.
rpghealthbar.itemName.title: Item Name Height
rpghealthbar.itemName.overlap: It never goes onto the HUD or the hotbar; it stops just above them.
rpghealthbar.edit.hint.one: Drag a piece to move it on its own. Arrow keys nudge it (Shift: 10px).
rpghealthbar.config.moveMode.tooltip.all: The whole HUD, with every piece keeping its place in it.
rpghealthbar.config.moveMode.tooltip.one: One piece on its own: armor, hunger, health, mana, or the XP bar with the level. Air bubbles and mount health move with hunger.
